symptoms.symptom: Burner(s) do not light or igniters do not spark.

causes.label: The gas shut-off valve is not in the “ON” position or the gas supply to the house is shut off.
remedies: Ensure that the gas shut-off valve is in the “ON” position and the gas supply to the house is not shut off.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 35: "The gas shut-off valve is not in the “ON” position or the gas supply to the house is shut off."

causes.label: The burner caps, burner bases or burner ports are clogged.
remedies: Ensure that the burner caps and burner bases and the burner ports are not
clogged.
Clear ports with a wire or straightened paper clip if clogged.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 35: "The burner caps, burner bases or burner ports are clogged."

symptoms.symptom: The burner flame goes out unexpectedly.

causes.label: There is a draft in the room.
remedies: Ensure that there is no draft in the room.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 36: "There is a draft in the room."

symptoms.symptom: Cooktop burner(s) does not start correctly or flame extinguishes at burner as soon as knob is released.

causes.label: The pushing time was too short or the pushing was too soft.
remedies: Use the recommended lighting position .
Push the knob completely.
Keep it fully pushed during the whole lighting procedure.
Release the knob after min. 3-5 seconds.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 36: "The pushing time was too short or the pushing was too soft."

causes.label: The burner cap not well positioned.
remedies: Check the correct placement of the burner caps.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 36: "The burner cap not well positioned."

causes.label: Dirt or moisture on burner, spark plug or thermocouple.
remedies: Clean and dry these parts.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 36: "Dirt or moisture on burner, spark plug or thermocouple."

causes.label: Not enough gas in pipe.
remedies: Check main gas valves and pressure regulator and make sure that pipes are purged from air.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 36: "Not enough gas in pipe."

symptoms.symptom: The small burner or the dualflame burner does not light properly or is not stable or extinguishes.

causes.label: The small burner caps are swapped.
remedies: Check the correct placement of the burner caps.
The burner cap with the smallest diameter must always be placed in the middle of the dual-flame burner.
If one of your burner caps is marked with "DUAL", it has to be placed in the middle of the dual-flame burner.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 36: "The small burner caps are swapped."

symptoms.symptom: Sparks appear on the wrong burner.

causes.label: No fault: On starting one burner on all burners sparks will be generated.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 36: "No fault: On starting one burner on all burners sparks will be generated."

symptoms.symptom: The igniters spark even though the knobs are in the off position.

causes.label: The electrical power connection has been activated at the first power-up or reconnected after an outage.
remedies: The igniters may spark once or twice, even though all burner knobs are in the “OFF” position. This is normal.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 36: "The electrical power connection has been activated at the first power-up or reconnected after an outage."

symptoms.symptom: Cooking results are not as expected.

causes.label: The cooktop burner is not properly levelled.
remedies: Check the level of the cooktop burner during installation.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 36: "The cooktop burner is not properly levelled."

causes.label: The cookware does not fit on the surface being used.
remedies: Choose a different surface or a different piece of cookware.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 36: "The cookware does not fit on the surface being used."

causes.label: The cookware is not the recommended type or size.
remedies: See "Notes regarding cookware" and "Baking pans and dishes".
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 36: "The cookware is not the recommended type or size."

symptoms.symptom: The oven door feels hotter than before, after the oven door glass has been removed for cleaning.

causes.label: The oven door glass is not inserted the right way round.
remedies: Check if the oven door glass is inserted the right way round (low-E symbol can be read).
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 36: "The oven door glass is not inserted the right way round."

symptoms.symptom: The oven door is not balanced.

causes.label: The inner door glass is missing or has not been inserted during reassembly.
remedies: Check if the inner door glass is present or has been inserted during reassembly.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 36: "The inner door glass is missing or has not been inserted during reassembly."

symptoms.symptom: Cooling fan continues to run when the oven is switched off.

causes.label: No fault: The cooling fan will cool down until the oven temperature has reached the temperature chosen in the settings.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 36: "No fault: The cooling fan will cool down until the oven temperature has reached the temperature chosen in the settings."
